items.heading: Explains that the intended perfection is that all the Sefirot in the five worlds AK and ABYA connect together into the phase of the upper man, whose body is clothed with the root and the soul, and clothes in a garment, and sits in his chamber. In it there are four matters: — 1. The whole of reality divides into five worlds called AK and ABYA, corresponding to the five phases KHB TM, called: root, soul, body, garment, chamber. And in particular, there are five revealed phases in each world, each of which further divides into five revealed phases, meaning twenty-five particular phases in each and every world of AK and ABYA. And all twenty-five revealed phases in AK are regarded as roots, meaning Ketarim. And all twenty-five revealed phases in the world of Atzilut are regarded as souls, meaning Hochmot. And all twenty-five revealed phases in the world of Beria are regarded as bodies, meaning Binot. And all twenty-five revealed phases in the world of Yetzira are regarded as garments, meaning Tifferot. And all twenty-five phases in the world of Assiya are regarded as chambers, meaning Malchuyot. 2. The twenty-five particular revealed phases in the five worlds AK and ABYA connect with one another in this way: the five Ketarim in AK and ABYA, called the five roots, connect with one another into the revealed connection of the roots; Keter of AK is the root, and Keter of Atzilut is the soul among them, and Keter of Beria is the body among them, and Keter of Yetzira is the garment among them, and Keter of Assiya is the chamber among them. And likewise the five Hochmot in AK and ABYA, called the five souls, connect with one another into the revealed connection of souls, in that Hochma of AK is the root among them, and Hochma of Atzilut is the soul among them, and Hochma of Beria is the body among them, and Hochma of Yetzira is the garment among them, and Hochma of Assiya is the chamber among them. And likewise the five Binot in AK and ABYA, called the five bodies, connect with one another into the revealed connection of bodies, in that Bina of AK is the root among them, and so on. And likewise the five Tifferot of AK and ABYA. And likewise the five Malchuyot of AK and ABYA. And likewise in the particulars of the particulars of the revealed phases of AK and ABYA. 3. The five revealed phases are also called: Yechida, Chaya, Neshama, Ruach, Nefesh. 4. And likewise they are hinted at in the four letters of HaVaYaH: the tip of the Yod is the root; and the Yod is the soul; and the first Hei is the body; and the Vav is the garment; and the lower Hei is the chamber. — Adam Kadmon is the world of Keter to the four worlds ABYA. And in it there are five phases KHB TM, in each of which there are four roots of revealed phases.
items.html: 1And behold, Adam Kadmon is like the Keter to the ten Sefirot that are in each and every world, in this way: since AK is the Keter to the four worlds ABYA, it follows that AK comprises the root of all five phases mentioned above that exist in each and every world: as its Keter is four roots of the four phases of the ten Sefirot within it, which are: souls, and bodies, and garments, and chambers. 2This is by way of particulars; however, by way of generality it is what will now be explained, with God's help.

items.heading: The souls in AK are the roots of souls. The souls in Atzilut are the very essence of the souls. The souls in Beria are the bodies within the souls. The souls in Yetzira are the garments within the souls. The souls in Assiya are the chambers of the souls. In such a way, the souls, which are the Hochmot, in the five worlds AK and ABYA, connect with one another, as the upper man, whose body is clothed with root and soul, and garment in garment, and sits in his chamber.
items.html: For 3the whole phase of souls that is in AK is called the root of the souls. And the whole phase of the soul of Atzilut is called the very souls of souls. And the whole of the souls of Beria is called bodies, relative to the souls of Atzilut. And the whole of the souls of Yetzira is called garments of the souls. And the whole of the souls of Assiya is called the chambers of the soul.

items.heading: The bodies of AK are the roots of bodies. And the bodies of Atzilut are the souls of the bodies. And those of Beria are the essence of the bodies. And the bodies of Yetzira are the garments of the bodies. And the bodies of Assiya are the chambers of the bodies. And all the bodies of AK and ABYA connect with one another in the upper man, whose body is clothed with root and soul, and so on.
items.html: And likewise 4the whole phase of the bodies of AK is called the root of the bodies. And the whole phase of the bodies of Atzilut is called the souls of the bodies. And the whole phase of the bodies of Beria is called the bodies of the bodies. And the whole phase of the bodies of Yetzira is called the garments of the bodies. And the whole phase of the bodies of Assiya is called the chambers of the bodies.

items.heading: And likewise the garments in each world of AK and ABYA connect with one another, and become like the upper man, whose body is clothed with soul and root, and clothes in garments, and sits in his chamber.
items.html: And likewise the whole phase of the garments of AK is called the root of the garments. And the whole of the garments of Atzilut is called the souls of the garments. And the whole phase of the garments of Beria is called the bodies of the garments. And the whole phase of the garments of Yetzira is called the garments of the garments. And the whole of the garments of Assiya is called the chambers of the garments.

items.heading: And likewise the chambers in each world of AK and ABYA connect together, like the upper man, whose body is clothed, and so on.
items.html: And the whole phase of the chambers of AK is called the root of the souls of the chambers. And the whole phase of the chambers of Atzilut is called the souls of the chambers, and the whole of the chambers of Beria is called the bodies of the chambers. And the whole phase of the chambers of Yetzira is called the garments of the chambers. And the whole of the chambers of Assiya is called the chambers of the chambers.

items.heading: The revealed phases of AK are roots for the revealed phases in ABYA. The revealed phases of Atzilut are souls within the revealed phases in AK and BYA. The revealed phases of Beria are bodies within the revealed phases in AK and AYA. The revealed phases of Yetzira are garments within the revealed phases in AK and ABA. The revealed phases of Assiya are chambers within the revealed phases in AK and ABY.
items.html: And when we speak of all this by way of generality, it will be so: the five phases of AK are roots, both for souls, both for bodies, both for garments, and for chambers. And the five phases of Atzilut are souls: both for roots, both for souls, both for bodies, both for garments, and for chambers. And the five phases of Beria are bodies, both for roots, both for souls, both for bodies, both for garments, both for chambers. And the five phases of Yetzira are garments: both for roots, both for souls, both for bodies, both for garments, both for chambers. And the five phases of Assiya are chambers: both for roots, both for souls, both for bodies, both for garments, both for chambers.

items.heading: Beria is called body, because it receives from Atzilut as a body receives from a soul.
items.html: And by this you will understand what our sages said, "His wife is as his own body." For Beria is the wife of Atzilut, since they are Hochma and Bina as above. And although there are also souls in Beria, it is called bodies relative to the souls of Atzilut, for just as the wife receives from her husband, so the body receives from the soul. And likewise what our sages said, "There is no house but a wife," refers to Assiya, for indeed Assiya is the house and the chamber for all five phases, as above. And behold, Assiya is the wife of Yetzira, as is known, and this is "there is no house but a wife," in the phase of Assiya. And likewise, in the phase of Assiya that is in each and every world, it is called the house for that world. And the phase of Beria in each world is called the body for that world.

items.heading: Another way: the lights in AK, meaning the souls in it, are called Yechida. And the souls of Atzilut are called Chaya. And the souls of Beria are called Neshama. And the souls of Yetzira are called Ruach. And the souls of Assiya are called Nefesh.
items.html: *And if we wish, let us take another way, for all the lights of AK are called Yechida, and the lights of Atzilut are Chaya, and the lights of Beria are Neshama, and the lights of Yetzira are Ruach, and the lights of Assiya are Nefesh.

items.heading: And likewise with the bodies, garments, and chambers in AK and ABYA. The bodies in AK are the Yechida of the bodies of ABYA. And those in Atzilut are Chaya, and so on. And likewise with the garments, the garments of AK are the Yechida of the garments of ABYA, and the garments of Atzilut are the Chaya of the garments of AK and BYA, and so on.
items.html: And likewise with the garments in all the worlds, and with the bodies and the chambers, for all the garments of AK are the one, upper garment among all five garments, and all the garments of Atzilut are the second garment, and so on.

items.heading: The revealed phases are Yechida, Chaya, Neshama, Ruach, Nefesh, meaning the lights of KHB TM.
items.html: And this way is the first way, for indeed Nefesh is called the chamber, Ruach the garment, and Neshama the body, and Chaya the soul, and Yechida the root of the soul. It follows that all of the above is by way of particulars in each and every world, as follows: the light of Keter of Atzilut is called the root of the soul, and is called Yechida. And the light of Hochma of Atzilut is called the soul of the soul, and is called Chaya. And the light of Bina of Atzilut is called the body, and is called Neshama. And the light of Tifferet of Atzilut is called the garment, and is called Ruach. And the light of Malchut of Atzilut is called the chamber, and is called Nefesh. And likewise in the particulars of the particulars, and so understand.

items.heading: Each Sefira of KHB TM in AK and ABYA divides further into the five revealed phases.
items.html: And indeed, the shortest, intermediate generality of all is this, that in each and every one of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, and Keter as well, there is: root, soul of the soul, body, garment, chamber. And likewise in BYA, and likewise in AK, which is the root for all of ABYA.

items.heading: AK and ABYA are the five phases in the name HaVaYaH, each included from the other, and in each of them there is AK and ABYA, which are the five phases in HaVaYaH. And they are the revealed phases, which are twenty-five phases.
items.html: It follows that all that was emanated is a single HaVaYaH, comprising five phases, which are: the tip of the Yod in AK, Yod in Atzilut, Hei in Beria, Vav in Yetzira, Hei in Assiya. And each of these phases is comprised of all five, for the tip of the Yod that is in AK contains one HaVaYaH of five other phases, which are the five phases mentioned above within AK itself, which are AK and ABYA within it, which are five phases, namely: root, and soul, and body, and garment, and chamber. And likewise the Yod of Atzilut contains one HaVaYaH, comprising all the five phases mentioned above. And likewise the other letters, in BYA. In such a way, they are five letters, each of them comprising all of them, which are twenty-five phases.

items.heading: Each of the twenty-five phases mentioned above divides further into five revealed phases, in each of which there are ten Sefirot, and each Sefira divides into five Partzufim, which are the revealed phases.
items.html: And afterward, in this manner as above, there is another generality, that each of them comprises all twenty-five phases. And it is that the Yod of Atzilut contains one HaVaYaH comprising all five phases, and each of the five phases comprises five, which are: ten Sefirot of root, and ten Sefirot of soul, and ten Sefirot of body, and ten Sefirot of garment, and ten Sefirot of chamber. And likewise with the tip of the Yod in AK, Yod in Atzilut, and likewise with the letter Hei in Beria, and with the letter Vav in Yetzira, and so on. It follows, in brief, that AK is the tip of the Yod, and it contains one HaVaYaH comprising five phases: root, and soul, and body, and garment, and chamber. And each of these phases comprises five, which are: ten Sefirot of root, and ten Sefirot of soul, and ten Sefirot of body, and ten Sefirot of garment, and ten Sefirot of chamber. And each Sefira of these ten Sefirot is comprised in five Partzufim, which are the root and ABYA.
